assessment.nobel_worthiness: Heterobifunctional degraders and molecular glues turn chemically induced proximity into a general drug modality, and rewrote the explanation of thalidomide-class drugs. Strong fit with chemistry that links molecular design to biology and clinical translation.
assessment.attribution: Crews and Deshaies conceived and demonstrated the PROTAC concept; Ciulli supplied structure-guided VHL ligands and mechanistic rigor. Handa, Ito and others made decisive cereblon-mechanism contributions, so the three-name cap forces a hard omission.
assessment.maturity: Many degraders are in clinical trials and the cereblon and VHL mechanisms are confirmed independently, but approved PROTAC drugs are still lacking. Timing is early but plausible.
uncertainties: Eight credited names with a three-laureate cap; molecular-glue (thalidomide) credit may need separate recognition.
I am not certain of the current clinical approval status of PROTAC drugs.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Base editors are chemistry-driven protein engineering that installs single-nucleotide changes without double-strand breaks. Broad adoption in research and the first clinical applications.
assessment.attribution: Liu led the work; Komor (cytosine base editors) and Gaudelli (adenine base editors) carried out the first-author inventions. Kondo and Nishida's independent deaminase-based work complicates credit.
assessment.maturity: Reproduced widely and entering clinical trials. Recognition might be seen as premature or as an extension of the 2020 CRISPR prize.
uncertainties: Overlap with the 2020 genome-editing prize and possible Medicine-prize territory.
Whether credit should go to Liu alone.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Native chemical ligation made total chemical synthesis and semisynthesis of proteins routine, enabling site-specific modification, and is central to peptide and protein chemistry. Its impact is clear and lasting.
assessment.attribution: Kent and Dawson reported native chemical ligation in 1994; Muir developed expressed protein ligation and semisynthesis. Danishefsky, Brik and Liu made major later contributions.
assessment.maturity: Three decades of confirmation and broad use, so timing is mature.
uncertainties: Danishefsky and others may contest priority for later ligation extensions.
Whether Muir's semisynthesis forms a separate compound discovery.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Liquid-liquid phase separation changed how cellular organization is understood, linking the physical chemistry of polymers and peptides to condensate function. This matches my background in self-assembly and designed peptides.
assessment.attribution: Hyman and Brangwynne demonstrated P granules as liquid droplets; Rosen showed multivalent-domain phase separation in vitro. Pappu and Mittag contributed essential theory and sequence grammar.
assessment.maturity: Wide adoption, but the physiological relevance and mechanistic role of many condensates remain debated, so it may be somewhat early.
uncertainties: Debate over the biological functional significance of condensates.
Credit is spread over biology and physical-chemistry contributors.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Energy landscape and funnel theory explained how proteins fold quickly and shaped biophysical chemistry, and it conceptually underlies protein structure prediction and design.
assessment.attribution: Wolynes and Onuchic developed the funnel and landscape framework; Dill contributed the hydrophobic collapse and lattice model view; Fersht gave experimental mapping that is also decisive.
assessment.maturity: Concepts are long established and validated, though the field already received 2024 recognition for prediction and design.
uncertainties: Fersht's experimental role is left out by the three-name cap.
Overlap with the 2024 prize on protein structure.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Massively parallel sequencing transformed the life sciences and medicine, with sequencing-by-synthesis chemistry at its core. Impact is very large.
assessment.attribution: Balasubramanian and Klenerman developed Solexa sequencing-by-synthesis chemistry; Rothberg's pyrosequencing-based platform was a parallel path. Mayer and Ju also have claims.
assessment.maturity: Mature technology with decades of validation and a clear impact.
uncertainties: Several competing technology lineages and commercial disputes.
Could be judged more as a method for Medicine or Physiology.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Nanopore sensing reads single DNA and RNA molecules electrically, and long-read sequencing is now in broad use. A strong single-molecule biophysical and analytical advance.
assessment.attribution: Deamer, Branton and Kasianowicz proposed and showed the concept; Bayley engineered protein pores; Akeson showed strand sequencing and ratcheting with polymerase. Allocation is contested.
assessment.maturity: Commercial devices are established and independently validated, so recognition would be timely.
uncertainties: Contested allocation among five or more credible contributors.
I am uncertain about the current living status of some of the named people.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: DNA-programmed nanoparticle assembly and spherical nucleic acids link gold-nanoparticle plasmonic properties to programmable biomolecular recognition, with biosensing and therapeutic uses. I find this close to my own research interests.
assessment.attribution: Mirkin's group and Alivisatos's group published the 1996 DNA-gold nanoparticle assembly papers; Mirkin developed spherical nucleic acids subsequently. Storhoff and Mucic were trainees.
assessment.maturity: Diagnostic and therapeutic translation is real but the long-term impact is smaller than for the stronger candidates above; timing is uncertain.
uncertainties: Alivisatos was recognized in nanocrystal areas and the 2023 prize covered quantum dots.
Relative magnitude of impact beyond diagnostics.
